QuestInfo.name: Mir's Awakening
QuestInfo.1: Mir has said that the Cygnus Empress has agreed to help out the Resistance, and that it wouldn't be a bad idea to receive her help yourself. Mir overheard the Empress asking for some kind of ore from the mysterious mine...so maybe you should get some too, and bring it to the Empress at the Conference Pavillion.
QuestInfo.2: Through the combined powers of the Sodalite and Cygnus Empress, your potential has been unlocked! Behold your awesome power!

npc.0: Can you go to the mysterious mine and collect some #b#t4033106##k for Empress Cygnus? 10 will do. To get to there, select #b"Talk to Mir."#k
